# FROZEN — do not edit anything in this directory

This is the manuscript as **submitted** (Access-2026-27906, June 2026) and **rejected**. It is the
artifact the four reviewers read. Its value is entirely as an unaltered record.

Editing anything here destroys the ability to answer "what did the reviewer actually see?", which is

Active work lives in `../2_resubmission/`.

Scope warning: this manuscript describes the OLD three-scenario study (LNDb + LIDC + end-to-end),
